messages:
Ana: Heads-up from today's compact-table playtest 9 users missed the kebab/menu on rows with checkboxes.
Lee: Thanks. Are we talking compact density only?
Ana: Yep, compact with multi-select. The three-dot sits flush to the row edge and click target felt tiny.
Rory: Can we add an invisible hitpad so the icon stays visually 20px but the interactive area grows to ~32px? Suggest token `--compact-action-hitpad: 6px`.
Kai: That sounds good. For mobile we keep 44px, desktop 32px is fine. Implementation: `.action-btn { width:20px; height:20px; padding:var(--compact-action-hitpad); box-sizing:content-box; }`
Ana: Also toasts from row actions are appearing under sticky filters on this page and briefly obscure controls. Current copy is just one word like "Deleted".
Lee: Standardize toast copy to: "<Action> <object> 	3 Undo" (e.g., "Deleted 1 rule 	3 Undo"). Anchor toasts to the page frame bottom-right for dense lists.
Rory: We can render a `.page-toasts` container inside `.page-frame { position:relative }` with `position:absolute; right:24px; bottom:var(--toast-anchor-bottom,24px);` so pages opt in. Use `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"` for SR announcements.
Kai: Accessibility: the kebab must be a real `<button>` with `aria-haspopup=\"menu\"`, `aria-expanded` and SR label "Actions for <row name>". Portal the menu to body to avoid clipping but remember to return focus.
Ana: Quick plan: Rory to open a token PR for `--compact-action-hitpad`, Kai to add Storybook for compact table with sticky filters, Lee to update the copy guide. I'll run 6 quick hallway tests focusing on discoverability and toast overlap.
preview-bot: Preview ready: https://preview.redwood/design/compact-hitpad (branch: feat/compact-action-hitpad).
Ana: Thanks all. Goal: land minimal token + toast container opt-in this week if hallway tests look good. :thumbsup:
